preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and n + (n // 2) inclusive, ensuring the graph is connected and each vertex belongs to at most one simple cycle.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.
The number of edges provided matches the specified m.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d, int) and d >= 0 for d in result)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum distance from a node to a leaf in the resulting tree.

postconditions.expression: all(d <= n - 1 for d in result)
postconditions.description: Each distance is at most n-1, the maximum possible distance in a tree with n nodes.
